about: Details of every /api/* route in routes.json, used by openapi.py to build docs/api/openapi.json. Routes, methods and auth come from routes.json; response documents reference the contract schemas in specs/001-platform-bootstrap/contracts/schemas by file name. 'action' means the shared action-result schema.

tags.name: Roof
tags.description: Move the roof and clear a fault.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Read and change the device's settings.

tags.name: Alerts
tags.description: Alerts: whether they're sent, recent ones, tests.

GET /api/status.description: Firmware, memory, flash, time, WiFi (with IPv6 addresses), MQTT, alerts, Alpaca clients and connections. Also pushed over `/ws/status`.

GET /api/settings/effective.description: Each setting that depends on another, and whether it's in effect or inactive, with the reason.

GET /api/config.description: Every setting. Passwords and keys are masked.

POST /api/config.description: Partial update: only the fields sent change. A masked or empty password keeps the stored one; `null` clears it. A wrong value is refused with `error` naming it; a setting whose dependency is off is saved and reported inactive by `/api/settings/effective`. Refused with 409 while the roof is opening or closing or a close is waiting to start (flash writes stall its control task); while the save runs, an open is refused and a close waits for it.

PUT /api/config.description: The same as `POST /api/config`, for clients that use PUT. Refused with 409 while the roof is opening or closing or a close is waiting to start (flash writes stall its control task); while the save runs, an open is refused and a close waits for it.

POST /api/backup.description: The backup file: every setting as `GET /api/config` shows it, with a header. With a `passphrase` (8 characters or more) the passwords, keys and tokens are included encrypted (AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256); without one the file holds no secret. Answered from a background task: a second or two with a passphrase. Refusals carry a `code`: 400 `passphrase-short`, 409 `busy` while another backup or preview runs, 413 `too-large`.

POST /api/backup/preview.description: Reads a backup file (`backup`, its text or its JSON) and, with its `passphrase`, its secrets, and answers what applying would save: the settings (masked), which secrets change, settings this board can't use and why it would restart. Nothing is applied; the `token` binds this preview to `POST /api/backup/apply`. Refused with `code` `not-backup`, `damaged`, `newer-format`, `wrong-passphrase` or `invalid` (the save's own reason in `error`).

backup.description: The backup file's text, or its JSON.

POST /api/backup/apply.description: Saves exactly the settings the preview with this `token` showed, as one settings save, and restarts the device about 2 s later when `restarting` is true. 409 `stale` when the preview was already applied or replaced, is older than 10 minutes, or the settings changed since: preview again. Refused with 409 while the roof is opening or closing or a close is waiting to start (flash writes stall its control task), and, when it would restart, also while the automatic close is waiting for the park or closing.

POST /api/restart.description: Restarts the device after answering. Refused with 409 (with the reason) while the roof is opening or closing, a close is waiting to start, or the automatic close is waiting for the park or closing.

POST /api/roof/open.description: Asks the roof to open, as a person. Refused unless the weather verdict is safe (constitution III), and by the motion logic (a latched fault, the Hall reading not settled, the supply low or unreadable, current sense on and unreadable, invalid settings), and with `busy` while an upload or command-line OTA is writing the flash, an MQTT connect is under way or a restart is scheduled. An accepted open starts after the 500 ms dead time and ends on the open magnet; `GET /api/status` `roof` shows its progress. An open in progress stops if the weather stops being safe. Refused with `hotspot` while the setup hotspot, which has no password, is on. Needs the header `X-RoofRoof: 1`.

state.description: The roof's state after the command.

reason.description: Why it was refused (409 only): `weatherNotSafe`, `mountNotParked`, `faultLatched`, `hallNotSettled`, `positionUnknown`, `supplyLow`, `supplyUnreadable`, `currentUnreadable`, `settingsInvalid`, `busy` (an upload or other flash write, a WiFi change or scan, an MQTT connect or a scheduled restart; open only), `restarting` (a restart about to happen), `hotspot` (open while the setup hotspot is on) or `notStarted`.

error.description: The refusal for people, with the measured value and the limit or the input that failed (409 only).

pending.description: A close accepted that starts once an upload or MQTT connect has stopped (202 only).

message.description: What the waiting close is waiting for (202 only).

POST /api/roof/close.description: Asks the roof to close, as a person. Refused unless the mount is confirmed parked: N.I.N.A. reports it at park and every fitted park switch reads closed (constitution II); refused by the motion logic as for open. A close in progress stops with a `parkInterlock` fault if the park confirmation is lost. Needs the header `X-RoofRoof: 1`. A close always wins: it cancels a scheduled restart and stops an upload in progress (the upload fails with 409). While an upload, another flash write or an MQTT connect is still finishing, the close is accepted with 202 and `pending: true` and starts as soon as it is done (`roof.closePending` in the status).

POST /api/roof/stop.description: Switches the motor off at once and keeps the position estimate. Always accepted. Needs the header `X-RoofRoof: 1`.

state.description: The roof's state after the command.

POST /api/roof/clear-fault.description: Clears a latched motion fault, as a person, and removes it from storage. The position is known again only at a magnet. Accepted with no fault too. Needs the header `X-RoofRoof: 1`.

GET /api/wifi/scan.description: The first call starts a background scan and answers 202 with `scanning: true`; call again about once a second until `scanning` is false and the list arrives. Refused with 409 while the roof is opening or closing, a close is waiting to start or the automatic close is waiting for the park or closing (the radio leaves its channel during a scan); while a scan runs (at most 15 s), an open is refused and a close waits.

POST /api/wifi/connect.description: What the WiFi setup screen uses. Answers 202 at once; poll `/api/status` (`wifi.connectPending`, then `wifi.connected`). On success the network is saved and the device restarts onto it 15 s later. Send `""` as the password for an open network. Refused with 409 (with the reason) while the roof is opening or closing, a close is waiting to start, or the automatic close is waiting for the park or closing: it drops the current network for up to 10 s. Until it has joined (at most 15 s), an open is refused and a close waits.

POST /api/mqtt/test.description: Tries to connect with the given details without saving them. A `password` of `********` (the mask settings return) or empty means the saved password, which is only used when broker, port and username match the saved ones; for any other broker a masked password is refused with 400.

POST /api/update.description: A firmware `.bin` for this device's build and partition layout. 400 when the file is for another layout (nothing changed); 500 keeps the running firmware. The device restarts on success. Refused with 409 (with the reason) before anything is written while the roof is opening or closing, a close is waiting to start, or the automatic close is waiting for the park or closing, or a person has stopped it (a new firmware may not read what it keeps across a restart); the restart after it waits for the roof and the close. An upload in progress is stopped by a roof close (409, "Upload stopped: the roof is closing").

POST /api/update/fs.description: A LittleFS image that fills the web UI partition exactly. A file for another layout is refused before anything is erased. Settings are kept. Refused with 409 (with the reason) while the roof is opening or closing, a close is waiting to start, or the automatic close is waiting for the park or closing (flash writes stall the control task, and the restart after it can't be cancelled). An upload in progress is stopped by a roof close (409, "Upload stopped: the roof is closing").

GET /api/alerts/armed.description: Whether alerts are being sent, the send mode and why it's sending or paused.

POST /api/alerts/arm.description: Takes effect at once and survives restarts.

POST /api/alerts/disarm.description: While paused nothing is sent. Takes effect at once and survives restarts.

GET /api/alerts/recent.description: Whether alerts are on, and the last 20 since boot, newest first, with each channel's delivery result (`pending`, `sent`, `failed`, `skipped`).

POST /api/alerts/test.description: Queues a test on the given saved, switched-on channel(s); see `/api/alerts/recent` for the result. A channel that can't deliver right now is recorded as `skipped`. Add `event`, `level` and `sound` for a sample of that event, or `title`/`message` to try custom wording with `{variables}`.
